{{Top|leg}}
The '''bruth''' was a predator native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorista]]. While regarded as vicious, the species was eventually domesticated by [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colonists.

Bruth was also a common name for Zabrak [[Gender/Legends|males]].
